body.zh-Hant: 板垣征四郎為日本陸軍大將，1885年1月21日生於岩手縣，畢業於陸軍士官學校與陸軍大學校。明治37年他以少尉身分從軍參加日俄戰爭，在奉天近郊負重傷，被送回內地。此後他在參謀本部任職，並擔任駐北京公使館武官的補佐官。
body.en: Itagaki Seishiro was an Imperial Japanese Army general, born in Iwate Prefecture on 21 January 1885 and a graduate of the Army Academy and the Army War College. As a second lieutenant in 1904 (Meiji 37) he served in the Russo-Japanese War and was badly wounded outside Mukden, then sent back to Japan. He later served on the General Staff and as assistant to the military attache at the Peking legation.

citations.quote: 明治18年1月21日岩手県に生まれる
陸軍士官学校
明治37年少尉で日露戦争に従軍、奉天郊外で重傷、内地送還
参謀本部員のあと北京(ペキン)公使館付陸軍武官

body.zh-Hant: 昭和4年（1929）起，他出任關東軍高級參謀，與部下石原莞爾共同策劃，於昭和6年9月引發滿州事變。事變後，昭和7年他以關東軍司令部附的身分擔任滿洲國執政顧問，昭和9年任滿洲國軍政部最高顧問。
body.en: From 1929 (Showa 4) he served as senior staff officer of the Kwantung Army. Together with his subordinate Ishiwara Kanji he plotted and launched the Manchurian Incident in September 1931. In 1932 he became adviser to the Manchukuo chief executive, attached to the Kwantung Army headquarters, and in 1934 chief adviser to the Manchukuo military administration department.

citations.quote: 4年関東軍高級参謀となり、部下の石原莞爾と謀って6年9月満州事変を起こした
7年関東軍司令部付満州国執政顧問として溥儀を指導、9年満州国軍政部最高顧問

heading.zh-Hant: 關東軍參謀長與陸軍大臣
heading.en: Kwantung Army chief of staff and War Minister

body.zh-Hant: 昭和11年他任關東軍參謀長，12年任第5師團長。13至14年間，他在第1次近衛內閣及平沼內閣擔任陸軍大臣，在日德義三國同盟問題上與海相米內光政對立。14年他轉任支那派遣軍總參謀長，是在中國本土展開的日軍作戰的責任者。
body.en: In 1936 (Showa 11) he became chief of staff of the Kwantung Army and in 1937 commander of the 5th Division. From 1938 to 1939 he served as army minister in the first Konoe cabinet and the Hiranuma cabinet, clashing with navy minister Yonai Mitsumasa over the Tripartite Pact. In 1939 he became chief of staff of the China Expeditionary Army, the officer responsible for the Japanese operations in mainland China.

heading.zh-Hant: 朝鮮軍、第七方面軍與戰後
heading.en: Korea Army, 7th Area Army and aftermath

body.zh-Hant: 昭和16年（1941）他晉升大將並任朝鮮軍司令官，20年任第17方面軍司令官，接著任第7方面軍（新加坡）司令官。戰敗後，他在東京審判中以甲級戰犯被判絞刑，昭和23年（1948）12月23日處刑。
body.en: In 1941 he was promoted to full general and became commander of the Korea Army; in 1945 he commanded the 17th Area Army and then the 7th Area Army (Singapore). After the surrender he was sentenced to death by hanging as a Class A war criminal at the Tokyo trial and executed on 23 December 1948.

heading.zh-Hant: 滿州事變與華北工作的作戰
heading.en: Operations: the Manchurian Incident and North China schemes

body.zh-Hant: 板垣征四郎在關東軍任高級參謀，與作戰參謀石原莞爾一同於1931年（昭和6）引發滿州事變這場戰役；辭典稱石原為作戰主任參謀，並稱兩人是這場事變的演出者。昭和11年（1936）他任關東軍參謀長，據世界大百科事典，他推動了華北工作與內蒙工作。另據百科事典，昭和14年（1939）他任支那派遣軍總參謀長，被稱為在中國本土展開之日軍作戰上的責任者。
body.en: As a senior staff officer of the Kwantung Army, Itagaki Seishiro and operations staff officer Ishiwara Kanji set off the Manchurian Incident in 1931; one dictionary calls Ishiwara the chief operations staff officer and describes the two as the directors of the incident. In 1936 he became chief of staff of the Kwantung Army, and the Sekai Daihyakka Jiten says he promoted the so-called North China and Inner Mongolia schemes. Another encyclopedia states that in 1939, as chief of staff of the China Expeditionary Army, he became the officer responsible for the operations of Japanese forces deployed in mainland China.

body.zh-Hant: 栗林忠道是日本陸軍軍人，1891年7月7日生於長野縣。他於1914年畢業於陸軍士官學校，1923年畢業於陸軍大學校。他於1945年3月26日歿於硫黃島，享年55歲。
body.en: Kuribayashi Tadamichi was a Japanese army officer, born in Nagano on 7 July 1891. He graduated from the Army Academy in 1914 and from the Army War College in 1923. He died on Iwo Jima on 26 March 1945, aged 55.

citations.quote: 1914年陸軍士官学校，1923年陸軍大学校卒業

body.zh-Hant: 據辭典記載，他曾任駐加拿大公使館武官、第23軍參謀長，也當過騎兵第一旅團長。這些職務的起迄年月辭典都沒有寫，因此本文不列任期。
body.en: According to the dictionaries he served as military attache at the legation in Canada, as chief of staff of the 23rd Army, and as commander of the 1st Cavalry Brigade. The dictionaries give no dates for these posts, so no terms are listed here.

citations.quote: カナダ公使官付き武官，第 23軍参謀長などを歴任
騎兵第一旅団長などをへて昭和19年第百九師団長となり

body.zh-Hant: 昭和19年（1944）他任第109師團長，率領約2萬2000名將兵守備硫黃島。1945年美軍登陸後，守備隊全滅；他於3月26日被認定戰死，並追晉大將。守備部隊在3月26日以殘兵800人發動最後突擊而玉碎，美軍約2萬9000人死傷。他在全滅前向大本營發出電文，稱「今や彈丸盡き，水涸れ，全員反撃し，最後の敢闘を行わんとす」。
body.en: In 1944 (Showa 19) he became commander of the 109th Division and defended Iwo Jima with some 22,000 troops. After American forces landed in 1945 the garrison was annihilated; he was recognised as killed in action on 26 March and promoted posthumously to full general. On 26 March the remaining 800 men made a last charge and were wiped out, after inflicting about 29,000 casualties on the American side. Before the end he telegraphed Imperial Headquarters that ammunition and water were exhausted.

body.zh-Hant: 梅津美治郎是大正、昭和時期的陸軍大將，明治15年（1882）1月4日生於大分縣。他於明治36年畢業於陸軍士官學校，明治44年畢業於陸軍大學校，明治37年從軍參加日俄戰爭。
body.en: Umezu Yoshijiro was an army general of the Taisho and Showa eras, born in Oita Prefecture on 4 January 1882. He graduated from the Army Academy in 1903 and the Army War College in 1911, and served in the Russo-Japanese War in 1904.

citations.quote: 大正・昭和期の陸軍大将
生年明治15(1882)年1月4日
陸士〔明治36年〕卒,陸大〔明治44年〕卒
明治37年日露戦争に従軍

body.zh-Hant: 他於1913年至1920年間先後以駐在武官身分派駐德國、丹麥與瑞士，觀察第一次世界大戰。依人名事典，大正4年駐丹麥，8年任駐瑞士公使館武官。
body.en: Between 1913 and 1920 he was posted as a military attache in Germany, Denmark and Switzerland and observed the First World War. According to a biographical dictionary he was stationed in Denmark in 1915 and became attache at the Swiss legation in 1919.

citations.quote: 1913年（大正2）より1920年までドイツ、デンマーク、スイスの駐在武官を歴任して
第一次世界大戦を観察した
大正4年デンマーク駐在、8年スイス公使館付武官

heading.zh-Hant: 支那駐屯軍與陸軍次官
heading.en: China Garrison Army and vice minister

body.zh-Hant: 昭和9年（1934）他任支那駐屯軍司令官，次年簽訂梅津‧何應欽協定，該協定成為日本進出華北的槓桿。昭和11年他出任陸軍次官，在二二六事件後推動肅軍人事。
body.en: In 1934 he became commander of the China Garrison Army and in 1935 concluded the Umezu-He Yingqin Agreement, which became a lever for Japan's advance into North China. In 1936 he became army vice minister and carried out the purge of personnel after the 26 February Incident.

10年梅津・何応欽協定を締結

11年陸軍次官となり2.26事件後の粛軍人事を断行

heading.zh-Hant: 第1軍、關東軍與參謀總長
heading.en: 1st Army, Kwantung Army and Chief of the General Staff

body.zh-Hant: 昭和13年他任第1軍司令官，14年任關東軍司令官；據百科事典，這是在諾門罕事件剛結束之後，為改善對蘇關係而破例的拔擢。昭和15年晉升大將，19年7月就任參謀總長，成為最後一任參謀總長。
body.en: In 1938 he commanded the 1st Army and in 1939 the Kwantung Army; an encyclopedia says this was an exceptional appointment just after the Nomonhan Incident, meant to normalise relations with the Soviet Union. He was promoted to full general in 1940 and became Chief of the General Staff in July 1944, the last holder of the post.

citations.quote: 13年第1軍司令官。14年関東軍司令官。15年大将。19年参謀総長
ノモンハン事件直後の 39年対ソ関係正常化のために関東軍司令官に異例の抜擢をされた
1944年7月参謀総長となる
44年7月最後の参謀総長に就任

body.zh-Hant: 昭和20年（1945）9月2日，他在美艦密蘇里號上，與重光葵一同簽署降伏文書。戰後他在遠東國際軍事審判中以甲級戰犯被判終身禁錮，於昭和24年（1949）1月8日在服刑中病逝。
body.en: On 2 September 1945, aboard the USS Missouri, he signed the instrument of surrender together with Shigemitsu Mamoru. After the war the Tokyo tribunal sentenced him to life imprisonment as a Class A war criminal; he died of illness in prison on 8 January 1949.

citations.quote: 敗戦の20年9月2日、米艦ミズーリ号上で重光葵とともに全権として降伏文書に調印
A級戦犯,終身刑で服役中の昭和24年1月8日病没

heading.zh-Hant: 戰爭末期的作戰立場（本土決戰）
heading.en: Late-war operational stance: the decisive homeland battle

body.zh-Hant: 梅津美治郎於昭和19年（1944）7月就任最後一任參謀總長。據百科事典，他在1945年硫黃島戰役中島嶼陷落後仍主張繼續戰爭，並在討論接受波茨坦宣言的御前會議上支持本土決戰。
body.en: Umezu Yoshijiro became the last Chief of the General Staff in July 1944. According to an encyclopedia entry, even after the fall of Iwo Jima in 1945 he argued for continuing the war, and at the Imperial Conference on accepting the Potsdam Declaration he supported a decisive battle on the homeland.

body.zh-Hant: 植田謙吉是明治至昭和前期的軍人，明治8年（1875）3月8日生於大阪，畢業於陸軍大學校。他於昭和37年（1962）9月11日去世，享年87歲。
body.en: Ueda Kenkichi was a military man of the Meiji to early Showa period, born in Osaka on 8 March 1875 and a graduate of the Army War College. He died on 11 September 1962, aged 87.

citations.quote: 明治8年3月8日生まれ
大阪出身。陸軍大学校卒
昭和37年9月11日死去。87歳

body.zh-Hant: 昭和7年（1932）上海事變時，他以第九師團長身分出動。依百科事典，該年2月18日他要求中國軍撤出租界20公里以外，20日開始總攻擊；3月1日第11師團在中國軍背後登陸，第9師團也發動總攻，3日日方單方面宣布停戰。同年天長節慶祝會場上，朝鮮獨立運動家尹奉吉投擲炸彈，使他失去一隻腳。
body.en: In the Shanghai Incident of 1932 (Showa 7) he took the field as commander of the 9th Division. According to an encyclopedia, on 18 February he demanded that Chinese troops withdraw at least 20 km from the concession and began a general attack on the 20th; on 1 March the 11th Division landed behind the Chinese forces while the 9th Division also attacked, and on 3 March Japan unilaterally announced a halt to fighting. That year, at the Emperor's birthday celebration, a bomb thrown by the Korean independence activist Yun Bong-gil cost him a leg.

20日総攻撃を開始したが
3月1日第11師団が中国軍の背後に上陸，第9師団も総攻撃をかけ
3日一方的に戦闘中止を声明した
同年天長節祝賀会場で朝鮮の独立運動家尹奉吉(ユン-ポンギル)がなげた爆弾により片足をうしなう

heading.zh-Hant: 關東軍司令官與諾門罕事件
heading.en: Kwantung Army and the Nomonhan Incident

body.zh-Hant: 昭和9年他晉升陸軍大將，11年任關東軍司令官。14年他因諾門罕事件的敗戰責任被編入預備役。據百科事典，9月15日莫洛托夫外長與東鄉茂德大使之間成立停戰協定，關東軍的植田司令官與磯谷廉介參謀長因敗戰責任被編入預備役。
body.en: He became a full general in 1934 (Showa 9) and commander of the Kwantung Army in 1936. In 1939 he was placed on the reserve list for responsibility for the defeat at Nomonhan. According to an encyclopedia, a ceasefire was agreed on 15 September between Foreign Minister Molotov and Ambassador Togo Shigenori, and Ueda and his chief of staff Isogai Rensuke were put on the reserve list for the defeat.

body.zh-Hant: 西尾壽造是明治至昭和前期的軍人，明治14年（1881）10月31日生於鳥取縣，畢業於陸軍大學校。他於昭和35年（1960）10月26日去世，享年78歲。
body.en: Nishio Toshizo was a military man of the Meiji to early Showa period, born in Tottori Prefecture on 31 October 1881 and a graduate of the Army War College. He died on 26 October 1960, aged 78.

citations.quote: 明治14年10月31日生まれ
鳥取県出身。陸軍大学校卒
昭和35年10月26日死去。78歳

body.zh-Hant: 他曾參加日俄戰爭，其後歷任關東軍參謀長、參謀次長、近衛師團長與教育總監。這些職務的起迄年月，辭典都沒有寫明，因此本文不列任期。
body.en: He served in the Russo-Japanese War and afterwards held the posts of chief of staff of the Kwantung Army, vice chief of the General Staff, commander of the Imperial Guard Division and Inspector General of Military Training. The dictionary gives no dates for these posts, so no terms are listed here.

heading.zh-Hant: 支那派遣軍與東京都長官
heading.en: China Expeditionary Army and Tokyo governor

body.zh-Hant: 昭和14年（1939）他任支那派遣軍總司令官，為陸軍大將。昭和19年（1944）他任東京都長官。
body.en: In 1939 (Showa 14) he became commander-in-chief of the China Expeditionary Army, a full general. In 1944 (Showa 19) he became governor of the Tokyo metropolis.

citations.quote: 昭和14年支那派遣軍総司令官となる。陸軍大将
19年東京都長官

heading.en: Study in Germany and staff and army-administration posts

body.zh-Hant: 據20世紀日本人名事典，西尾壽造在明治43年（1910）任軍務局課員，大正元年至3年被派往德國進行軍事研究。大正14年（1925）任步兵第40聯隊長，次年任教育總監部第1課長；昭和5年（1930）任陸軍省軍事調查委員長，7年任參謀本部第4部長，9年任關東軍參謀長，11年任參謀次長，12年任近衛師團長，13年任教育總監。
body.en: According to the 20th-century Japanese biographical dictionary, Nishio Toshizo became a section staff member of the Military Affairs Bureau in 1910 and was sent to Germany for military study in 1912-1914. He commanded the 40th Infantry Regiment in 1925, headed the first section of the Inspectorate General of Military Training in 1926, chaired the Army Ministry's military research committee in 1930, headed the Fourth Department of the General Staff in 1932, was chief of staff of the Kwantung Army in 1934, deputy chief of the General Staff in 1936, commander of the Imperial Guard Division in 1937 and Inspector General of Military Training in 1938.

citations.quote: 43年軍務局課員、大正1〜3年軍事研究のためドイツ派遣
14年歩兵第40連隊長、15年教育総監部第1課長、昭和5年陸軍省軍事調査委員長
7年参謀本部第4部長、9年関東軍参謀長、11年参謀次長
12年近衛師団長、13年教育総監、14年大将となり支那派遣軍総司令官

heading.zh-Hant: 日俄戰爭戰役與支那派遣軍時期
heading.en: Russo-Japanese War campaign and the China Expeditionary Army

body.zh-Hant: 據人名事典，西尾壽造任步兵第40聯隊附後參加日俄戰爭這場戰役。昭和14年（1939）他晉升大將並任支那派遣軍總司令官，18年轉入預備役，19年任東京都長官。
body.en: The dictionary states that Nishio served with the 40th Infantry Regiment and took part in the Russo-Japanese War. In 1939 he was promoted to full general and became commander-in-chief of the China Expeditionary Army; he was placed on the reserve list in 1943 and became Governor of Tokyo in 1944.
